title: Create: Meat Blocks (MineFactory Textures)
description: Adds the OG textures for meat blocks and such.
body:
Adds the OG textures for meat blocks and such.

 

Changes raw/uncooked meat blocks, slaughterhouse, meat packer, and even a new texture for the meat furnace to fit those 2!

 

Also changes the compressed blocks and bait block to fit the OG textures.
